versions.changelog:
clevrpay 1.0.1

- Added explicit security & compliance notice that API endpoints are routed internally and not exposed in user instructions.
- Updated A-Pass workflow: users are now always instructed to manually open the Magic Link for authentication instead of automated/conditional browser handling.
- Clarified the withdrawal workflow by emphasizing use of the built-in withdraw command and referencing Access Core documentation.
- Refined API Reference to document only the available in-skill commands and their purposes.

Initial release of the clevrpay skill for trusted, compliant global crypto payments:

- Enables secure payments and compliant settlement using stablecoins and A-Tokens across supported EVM chains.
- Supports A-Pass (Access Pass) workflow for identity-based payment access and verification.
- Provides clean-funds circulation, deposit, withdrawal, and transfer of A-Tokens between verified parties.
- Global, low-cost cross-border payments for both human and AI agent users.
- Integrates with EVM wallet skills for wallet creation and transaction handling.
- Simple workflows to check A-Pass, register users, manage deposits/withdrawals, and verify institution whitelists.
